item.title: 不要浪费时间
item.description:
“Fais ce que dois, advienne que pourra” (Do your duty, come what may).

investing

the first rate hike this month did not stop the spending, both economy and job market seem stable. the quarterly reports in late October should give us some clues about the economy and the job market? the end cause is still the Iran war. so end the war, open Hormuz and let the oil flow.

item.title: reality is patient
item.description:
临溪流以静对，访草木以素心。登高极目知天地之大，置己苍茫知寸身之微。

当欲望得不到满足便痛苦，当欲望得到满足便无聊，人生就像钟摆一样在痛苦与无聊之间摆荡。– 叔本华(Arthur Schopenhauer, 1788 - 1860) (Life is a constant oscillation between the desire to have and the boredom of possessing. Life swings like a pendulum backward and forward between pain and boredom.)

杜甫 《登高》

风急天高猿啸哀，渚清沙白鸟飞回。
无边落木萧萧下，不尽长江滚滚来。
万里悲秋常作客，百年多病独登台。
艰难苦恨繁霜鬓，潦倒新停浊酒杯。

“We must always take sides. Neutrality helps the oppressor, never the victim. Silence encourages the tormentor, never the tormented. Sometimes we must interfere.” – Elie Wiesel

the only thing new in the world is the history you do not know. – Harry S. Truman
